brief: Saudi events: Riyadh's fourth-quarter calendar is thinning after the attacks on the kingdom. On 19 Oct the FII Institute moved FII10 (26 to 29 Oct) to 2027, the Saudi Retail Forum (19 Nov) moved to March 2027 and Intersec Saudi Arabia moved to October 2027; Riyadh Season is still due to open on 21 Oct.
AI: Emirates NBD will run OpenAI's GPT models on in-country UAE infrastructure for customer engagement, risk and compliance, announced on 19 Oct and billed as a first for a bank in the MENA region.
Destinations: the 32nd Dubai Shopping Festival will run from 4 Dec 2026 to 17 Jan 2027, which sets UAE malls' winter promotion and raffle calendar.

Agentic commerce: American Express has published a framework for recording what a shopper approved before an AI agent buys (13 Oct), an early model for disputes and refunds as agent-led shopping grows.

2027 Directory: Safari Mall in Abu Hamour, Doha, where Malabar Gold & Diamonds has opened its 13th Qatar showroom, is not on Brilliant or in the tracker and goes to sheet 10 as Check first; the Saudi postponements add facts to the 'Trading through turbulence' article idea.

findings.title: Saudi Retail Forum moves from 19 Nov 2026 to March 2027
findings.summary:
The Saudi Retail Forum, due in Riyadh on 19 Nov 2026, has been postponed to March 2027, The National reported on 19 Oct in its round-up of Riyadh events moved after Houthi missile and drone attacks on the kingdom.

The forum's website, run by Images RetailME, now carries a banner saying the event moves to March 2027. When checked on 20 Oct it gave no new day, venue or reason.
findings.why: A leading Riyadh retail-industry forum leaving the fourth-quarter calendar changes the speaker, sponsor and delegate picture for MECSR's own Saudi events, including RCM Jeddah on 7 and 8 Dec.

sources.label: Saudi Retail Forum website (Images RetailME) · checked 20 Oct 2026

directory.headline: Trading through turbulence
directory.angle: The July escalation hit hotels and sentiment while mall occupancy held; October's attacks on Saudi Arabia have now pushed Riyadh's big fourth-quarter business events into 2027. What the published numbers say about how Gulf retail property absorbs the shocks.
directory.fits: Front of book: What's New in 2027 (p5) · RPM
directory.facts: 19 Oct 2026: FII10 (Riyadh, 26 to 29 Oct) postponed to 2027 (FII Institute via Gulf Business); Saudi Retail Forum (19 Nov) moved to March 2027; Intersec Saudi Arabia (16 to 18 Nov) moved to October 2027; a Saudi-EU summit postponed (The National). 18 Oct: Kingdom Centre, Riyadh, moved office tenants to remote working while its mall stays open (AFP). Riyadh Season due to open 21 Oct.
directory.caution: Sensitive. Stick to organisers' own statements and published figures, no speculation on security, and re-check every event date before print.

findings.title: FII10 is postponed to 2027 and Intersec Saudi Arabia moves to October 2027
findings.summary:
The FII Institute said on 19 Oct 2026 that the tenth Future Investment Initiative, due in Riyadh from 26 to 29 Oct, will now be held in 2027, with new dates to be announced; Gulf Business reports that existing registrations and partnerships remain valid.

The National links the move to Houthi missile and drone attacks on the kingdom, including strikes on King Khalid International Airport. It also reports that Intersec Saudi Arabia, due from 16 to 18 Nov, will now be held in October 2027, according to its organiser Messe Frankfurt Saudi Arabia, and that a planned Saudi-EU summit has been postponed.
findings.why: Riyadh loses its largest business events of the quarter, which matters for hotel, mall and F&B traffic around the capital's venues and for planning around RCM Jeddah.

findings.title: Dubai Shopping Festival's 32nd edition is set for 4 Dec 2026 to 17 Jan 2027
findings.summary: Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment (DFRE) has announced that the 32nd Dubai Shopping Festival will run for 45 days, from 4 Dec 2026 to 17 Jan 2027, with citywide offers, mall raffles, concerts and limited-time deals. DSF Nights and the etisalat MOTB market return, and the edition adds a first DSF Beach Canteen. DFRE says the full programme will follow in the coming month.
findings.why: DSF is the UAE's biggest winter driver of mall footfall, and the confirmed dates set member malls' December and January promotion and raffle calendars.

findings.title: Malabar Gold & Diamonds opens its 13th Qatar showroom at Safari Mall, Abu Hamour
findings.summary: Malabar Gold & Diamonds has opened its 13th showroom in Qatar at Safari Mall in Abu Hamour, Doha, The Peninsula reported on 18 Oct 2026. The retailer has also reopened its renovated showroom at Al Watan Centre, first opened in 2011. No showroom sizes or opening date were given.
findings.why: A new jewellery tenant at a Doha community mall that the MECSR Directory does not yet list.

directory.check: Not on Brilliant (no Safari listing in the 12 Oct export) and not in tracker sheets 10 or 11 (checked 20 Oct). Not the same as 'Safari Shopping Centre, Logistics Village Qatar', already in sheet 10 as Check first.
directory.next: Confirm the owner and operator, GLA and opening year from the mall or a second source before adding.

findings.title: Emirates NBD to run OpenAI's GPT models with in-country UAE inference, billed as a first for a MENA bank
findings.summary:
Emirates NBD and OpenAI announced an enterprise collaboration on 19 Oct 2026 under which the bank will use OpenAI's GPT models, tools and in-country inference infrastructure in the UAE.

The bank plans to use them for customer engagement across its digital channels, risk and compliance analytics, knowledge-heavy workflows and staff productivity, connected to its internal systems, APIs and data. Gulf News reports it as the first such arrangement for a bank in the MENA region; no financial terms were published.
findings.why: A major UAE bank is putting generative AI into customer-facing channels while keeping data in the country, a reference point for members weighing AI in customer service against data-residency rules.

findings.title: American Express publishes an Intent Intelligence framework for purchases made by AI shopping agents
findings.summary:
American Express published its Intent Intelligence framework on 13 Oct 2026. It sets out how a shopper's instructions, such as the merchant and a maximum budget, are captured and approved before an AI agent buys, then passed to the card issuer as an Intent ID and a Proof of Intent Token that can be exchanged for a limited payment credential used at checkout instead of the card number.

The records can then support fraud checks, authorisation decisions and disputes. The framework is offered through the Amex Agentic Commerce Experiences (ACE) Developer Kit.
findings.why: It gives retailers and their service teams an early model for proving what a customer approved when an agent buys on their behalf, which will matter for refunds and disputes as agent-led shopping reaches the Gulf.
